text: By far one of the best things we splurged on for our wedding was a live painter and Heather was the absolute best. A picture is worth a thousand words but her portrait of us is worth a million. She had some of the best customer service both during consultations and during the event. She made sure to take notes of all the features we were wanting to make it our dream painting. Not only that but she took videos of moments throughout the event in case a better pose appeared than planned. She was happy to still do our original pose we asked for but she offered this moment below and we couldn't say no, all because she had those videos. She also sent them to me while we were on our honeymoon so I had something to look back on while we waited for photographs and the painting to be ready. It also rained on our wedding day and she captured some of our rainwater as a gift and also mixed some into her paint so a little bit of our day is in our painting forever. I have cried so many happy tears because of Heather. She has been the absolute best and I have nothing but amazing words for her.

text: If you are even remotely considering having Heather paint a special moment at your event, DO NOT HESITATE! My mom surprised us with Heather's painting services for our March wedding at the Trillium, and the image she painted will be cherished by me and my husband forever. I was floored by how much the painted images resembled us, and the venue is so stunning and she perfectly captured the feeling of our day. Our guests could not stop talking about how fun and impressive it was to stop by throughout the night and watch her paint - it turned out to be a point of entertainment and everyone was posting videos of the process on social media. On top of all that, Heather is just the sweetest, warmest human. She dresses up to "fit in" with the wedding guests and welcomes questions and photos from interested parties. I cannot recommend this enough!

text: From the moment I first saw Heather’s work on Instagram several years ago, I knew I needed her to paint my wedding in the future. So, when we got engaged in September 2021, I booked our venue and then immediately secured Heather for our NYE 2022 wedding!! From the very first conversation with Heather to our last, she was friendly and so easy to work with, not to mention insanely talented. She was the perfect addition to our wedding day! She captured our genuine emotions and the true joy we felt so perfectly. Not only was our painting even better than I could have ever imagined (and I had some high expectations), but our wedding guests had a blast watching her work during the reception. She does an amazing job of engaging with guests and adding the perfect amount of entertainment. She grabs every single little detail from your day and brings it all to life on the canvas, and we had our finished painting back within a month of our wedding! It was an honor having Heather play such an important role in our wedding, and we will cherish our painting forever. I couldn’t recommend her more, so if you’re considering hiring her… DO IT! Truly one of the best decisions we made for our wedding.

owner_reply.text: Amanda!! I had a wonderful time celebrating NYE with your wedding party!! Thank you sooo much for your sweet words!! I wish you a lifetime of happiness!! 💗💗
